title: Constructed cartesian overlap object and transition data
statement: Fix a cartesian square g:X→Y, p′:X→T, p:Y→S, q:T→S, and opens U,V in Y, with shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Paste the cartesian open-restriction square with the given square. Its canonical scheme isomorphism identifies (g inverse U intersection g inverse V).toScheme with the pullback of (U intersection V).ι followed by p along q. Derived pullback along the inverse is the stage equivalence, with inverse derived pullback along the isomorphism; the units and counits come from the fixed composition and identity comparisons [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport, lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. For the apex, first derive Scheme.Modules.overEquiv on the inverse-image intersection and compose with the stage equivalence [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. These are actual constructions, not witnesses chosen from mere existence. For any L containing U intersection V, overlapOpenInclusionPullbackIso identifies exact nested-open restriction with pullback along the inclusion: compare its underived restriction functor with tensorPullback by uniqueness of left adjoints, and derive by uniqueness of the left-derived functor. perfectOverlapStageObjectIso then applies fixed composition to the cartesian projection equation to compare the actual stage objects. At the apex perfectOverlapApexObjectIso restricts the supplied local isomorphism and uses the inverse nested restriction comparison and the derived site counit. These explicitly construct all object comparisons. overlapLimitTransition is actual derived pullback along the canonical map between the geometric overlap base changes; overlapLimitBaseComparison is perfectHomComparison for that map. The theorem overlapLimitTransition_pin proves by unfolding that conjugation by this comparison is exactly perfectLimitMap.

proof.text: Reuse the adopted source module for the six constructed overlap equivalences and object comparisons, without redeclaring any source-library name.

Evaluate the nested restriction comparison on sections. The pushforward composition maps are identities, and the remaining three equality transports form an identity cycle. Compare the tensor and restriction adjunctions by uniqueness of left adjoints; their mates prove compatibility with composition. Combine these identities with the over-site equivalence unit and counit to identify the underived nested tensor comparison.

Use an explicitly typed private alias for the unchanged pinned counit and its proved left-derived property. Use the left-derived factorization equation to identify the canonical nested comparison after composing with this counit. Apply the exact-functor composition factorization and the open pinned source counit triangle. The underived identity from the previous step, mapped to homotopy categories and then localized, identifies the remaining term. Uniqueness of a left-derived natural transformation gives the derived compatibility equation.

Cancel the global open comparison and restriction composition isomorphisms to recover overlapOpenInclusionPullbackIso_whiskerLeft. Evaluate its hom and inv and cancel the inverse restriction factor to recover the two component equations.

Reuse the proved associativity identity of the pinned pullback composition for the three morphisms defining the cartesian stage object. Whisker the identity with the canonical inclusion comparison and append the cartesian projection equality and inverse composition comparison. Normalize the resulting natural isomorphisms and combine their equality transports before evaluating at the supplied object. This proves perfectOverlapStageObjectIso_hom_app for the unchanged canonical source definition without expanding derived-category component maps.

proof_origin.note: Preserve Q2's canonical zero-hole adapter and dependency route. Repair compilation performance: normalize module-category aliases in nested coherence, keep canonical comparisons and localization functors abstract, pin the derived-coherence functor parameters, expose an explicitly typed private alias of the canonical pinned counit, supply the three section transport proofs directly, normalize the source triangle on components, unfold private proof aliases directly, reuse the source associativity theorem, and prove the stage equation at the natural-isomorphism level before evaluating components. All private helpers are proved; all public statements and existing definitions are unchanged and no sorry is introduced. Homotopy calculations use stored representatives and component lemmas, with the cached abelian preadditive structures.

def perfectOverlapStageEquivalence
    {X Y S T : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (p' : X ⟶ T) (p : Y ⟶ S) (q : T ⟶ S)
    (h : IsPullback g p' p q) (U V : Y.Opens) :
    schemeDerivedCategory (g ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ g ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme ≌
      schemeDerivedCategory (pullback ((U ⊓ V).ι ≫ p) q)
